meta.title: Brand & Visual Assets
meta.subtitle: Guidelines and assets for the juststeveking.com brand identity.

primary.name: Inter
primary.creator: Rasmus Andersson
primary.description: A variable font family designed for user interfaces with a focus on high legibility of small-to-medium sized text.

technical.name: IBM Plex Mono
technical.creator: Mike Abbink / IBM
technical.description: Designed to illustrate the unique relationship between mankind and machine. Used for code, data, and metadata.

visualLanguage.label: Radius
visualLanguage.description: Rounded corners (0.75rem / 12px) are used across containers to convey a modern, approachable feel.

visualLanguage.label: Borders
visualLanguage.description: Subtle 1px borders using low-opacity variations of the text color define boundaries without visual noise.

visualLanguage.label: Spacing
visualLanguage.description: A strict spacing scale based on 4px increments ensures consistent rhythm and hierarchy.

visualLanguage.label: Transitions
visualLanguage.description: Smooth, 200ms transitions are applied to interactive elements for subtle feedback.
